subject: PoC inference cutover: architecture deep-dive — slot coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudscale.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Marsh <elena.marsh@cloudscale.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: architecture deep-dive ahead of PoC cutover

Hi Mina,

Hope you're well — we spoke briefly last week about moving our inference workload from EigenServe to Redwood for the upcoming PoC. Our CTO has asked for a technical deep-dive to validate the cutover plan and to surface any integration gaps before we lock dates.

High-level ask: 60–90 minute architecture review (networking, auth/KMS, data plane, KV cache behavior, and fallback routing). We have two engineers and our cloud lead who will join.

Can you propose 3 slots next week (US-PST) that work for your infra/solutions leads? For context I’ve attached a simple diagram of our current setup (cloudscale-current-setup.pdf).

Target outcomes:
- Confirm feasibility of prefix/KV cache reuse for our 80k concurrent users
- Identify any network/VPC peering or firewall rules required
- Agree on a pre-cutover smoke test checklist and runbook owner

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Price
Director of Cloud Engineering | CloudScale Systems
jordan.price@cloudscale.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

--
attachment: cloudscale-current-setup.pdf (diagram, 1 page)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Marsh <elena.marsh@cloudscale.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: architecture deep-dive ahead of PoC cutover

Jordan — thanks for the note and the diagram. Happy to run the architecture deep-dive. I’ve looped in Karthik (lead solutions architect) and Marissa (CS lead) so we bring the right ops/runbook context.

Proposed approach (90 minutes total):
1) 10m intros & scope
2) 30m current architecture + constraints (you + CloudScale engineers)
3) 30m Redwood serving runtime deep-dive (KV cache, batching, quantization options)
4) 15m pre-cutover checklist and outstanding action items

Pre-reqs: network diagram (thanks), a sample token budget estimate, and any constraints around egress/firewall rules. If you can drop those in the shared folder (I created one below) before EOD Monday we’ll tailor the runbook draft.

Available slots (US-PST):
- Wed Jul 12 — 10:00–11:30
- Thu Jul 13 — 13:00–14:30
- Fri Jul 14 — 08:30–10:00 (we can do earlier if required)

I’m attaching our PoC onboarding playbook (redwood-poc-playbook.pdf) and a proposed agenda (proposed-agenda.md). Meeting will be via Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij.

If none of those work, tell me best windows (morning/afternoon) and we'll try to accommodate.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (510) 555-0102

--

Thanks Mina — really helpful. We can do Thu Jul 13 but our cloud lead has an exec review that may run long. Could we shift the 13:00 slot to 14:00–15:30 instead? That would give him time to wrap.

If 14:00 is a hard constraint for your team, we can keep 13:00 and he’ll dial in late. Otherwise 14:00–15:30 works for everyone on our side.

--
Jordan
